_comment_embedding_mode: Decision 2026-09: use 'tile' (v3, the authors' full-tile / spatial-token-map approach), not 'bbox' (v7, adaptive bounding box) -- tile scored slightly better on IMMUcan. bbox kept available for comparison, not deleted.

defaults._comment_tile: tile_size/tile_stride are for --embedding-mode tile (v3). Same value used on both datasets (no evidence a smaller/larger tile changes token quality), but cHL's images are ~11x more pixels than IMMUcan's (2048x1536 vs 600x600) -> proportionally more forward passes per image. This is a runtime, not accuracy, concern -- flagged, not silently changed.

chl._comment_exclude_markers: Histone H3/dsDNA/anti-H2AX (pS139)/pSLP-76/SLP-76: same 5 excluded for every method on cHL. CD161/CD153 (CD30L)/CD28/IL-10 additionally excluded: Eva's marker_to_gene dict (eva/project/utils/constant.py, 213 entries) has no matching key for any of these under any plausible spelling -- verified directly, not assumed. Eva's embedding layer does a plain dict lookup with no fallback, so an unmapped/unmatched name is a hard KeyError, not a soft default (same failure mode as KRONOS2's marker_builder). This means Eva sees 37 markers here, not KRONOS1's 41.
chl._comment_exclude_labels: Per Lukas 2026-10: 'undefined' is kept as a real, scored class on cHL for every method -- other supervised methods in the benchmark predict and are scored on it too, so dropping it here would be inconsistent.
chl._comment_marker_name_map: Verified 2026-10 against eva/project/utils/constant.py's marker_to_gene dict directly (sys.path to eva/project, from utils.constant import marker_to_gene, checked every clean marker's mapped name is an actual key). The map inherited from before this check had 9 silently wrong entries (e.g. Tbet->TBX21, RORgT->RORC, PD-L1->CD274 -- none of those are real keys; Eva's vocabulary uses its own inconsistent naming, e.g. 'Tbet' unmapped, 'RORgammaT', 'PDL1') and 3 markers mapped to keys that don't exist at all (now moved to exclude_markers above since there's no correct target). Every entry below now resolves.
